paragraphs: Huna: Rabbi Avin bar Huna; Rav Chiyya bar Huna; Rav Yehudah bar Huna; Rav Shishi bar Huna (I did not find it). [Glosses: Huna. A) Berakhot 55b: Rav Huna bar Ammi said in Rabbi Pedat’s name, in Rabbi Yochanan’s name. In Ein Yaakov the reading is Rav Chanan bar Ammi; so it appears, see there. B) Bekhorot 31a: Rav Huna bar Chiyya became the king’s collector; so too in newer Talmud editions. Yuchasin writes Rabbi Chiyya bar Huna became the king’s collector. C) Chullin 47a: Rav Huna Mar bar Avya said to Rav Ashi; uncorrected [ל״ת]. In Asheri: bar Acha; uncorrected. There, 58b, that matter concerns a son of Rav Chiyya; uncorrected. In Asheri: son of Rav Nechemyah; uncorrected. In Bava Batra 143a, Rav Ashi said, “I saw Rav Huna bar Avya in a dream.” D) Pesachim 52b: Rav Safra left the Land of Israel; Rav Huna and Rav Kahana bar Rabbi Ika accompanied him. It seems to me it should read Rav Huna bar Rav Ika and Rav Kahana; so too in newer Talmud editions. E) Rav Huna bar Natan ruled after Rav Ashi, as stated in Moed Katan. Rav Ashi lived at least some eighty years, for he was academy head sixty years and was born when Rava died. We find Rav Nachman, Rava’s teacher, saying, “Huna bar Natan told me”: Ketubbot 7, end of side a. It requires examination whether he lived so long or there were two, since sometimes it says Rav Huna bar Natan and sometimes Rav Huna bar Rav Natan. F) Ketubbot 61, beginning of side a: Rav Huna said, “Rav Huna bar Chinena tested us: she says she will nurse and he says she will not nurse …; I resolved for him: she rises and does not descend.” Rav Huna said, “What verse? ‘She is married to a husband ….’” Rabbi Elazar said, “From here: ‘She was the mother of all living’—she was given for life.” This requires examination: Rav Huna died before Rav Yehudah, as Tosafot, Menachot 36a, says; Rava was born on Rav Yehudah’s death-day, as stated in chapter Asarah Yuchasin. In Niddah 46a—I did not find it there—Rav Huna bar Chinena objects to Rava. In Sanhedrin 87a, Rava told Rav Pappa, “Go and explain to Rav Huna bar Chinena.” How can Rav Huna say that Rav Huna bar Chinena tested us, as though he were Rav Huna’s teacher? Moreover, the language is puzzling: after Rav Huna answered that she rises with him, how does “Rav Huna said, ‘What verse?’” fit? It should have said briefly, “And does not descend with him. What verse? ‘She is ….’” Newer Talmud editions did not correct it. Perhaps it should read “Rav Huna bar Rav Nachman,” or “bar Rav Yehoshua,” “tested us ….” Rejoice, my soul, for I labored and found in Yalkut, Genesis, section 33: Rav Pappa said, “Rava tested us …; we resolved: she rises with him and does not descend with him. What verse? ‘She is ….’” Rabbi Elazar says, “From here ….” But it requires examination how it says Rabbi Elazar says, “From here,” since Rabbi Elazar preceded Rava. The reading before us is also in Alfasi, but Asheri’s reading is “Rav Pappa said: Rav Huna bar Chinena tested us”; this too is incorrect.]
